defs.def: the part of sth that is at an equal distance from all its edges or sides; a point or a period of time between the beginning and the end of sth 中间；中部；中央；中心

ex.s: Even in middle school I would stay up very late.
ex.t: 即使在中学时，我也会熬到很晚。

ex.s: When I was in middle school, my social studies teacher asked me to enter a writing contest I said no without thinking.
ex.t: 上中学时，我的社会课老师让我参加一个写作比赛，我想都没想就拒绝了。

ex.s: Turning soil, pulling weeds, and harvesting cabbage sound like tough work for middle and high school kids.
ex.t: 翻土、拔草和收卷心菜，对中学生和高中生来说听起来像是艰苦的劳动。

ex.s: Urban Sprouts’ classes, at two middle schools and two high schools, include hands-on experiments such as soil testing, flower-and-seed dissection, tastings of fresh or dried produce, and work in the garden.
ex.t: “城市萌芽”的课程在两所初中和两所高中开设，内容包括动手实验，如土壤检测、花和种子的解剖、品尝新鲜或晒干的农产品，以及在菜园里劳动。

ex.s: When I was in middle school, my social studies teacher asked me to enter a writing contest I said no without thinking.
ex.t: 上中学时，我的社会课老师让我参加一个写作比赛，我想都没想就拒绝了。

ex.s: Herman Cruse, a school bus driver from New Jersey, has been with Middle Township Public Schools for the past nine years.
ex.t: 赫尔曼·克鲁斯是新泽西州一名校车司机，过去九年在Middle Township公立学校工作。

ex.s: We were stuck in the middle of the lake with a dead motor.
ex.t: 我们困在湖中央，马达熄火了。

ex.s: "The sweet spot in life to start exercising, if you haven't already, is in late middle age when the heart still has flexibility," Levine says.
ex.t: "如果你还没有开始运动，生命中开始运动的最佳时期是中年晚期，这时心脏仍有弹性，"Levine说。

ex.s: In India and the Middle East, it’s considered very rude to eat with your left hand.
ex.t: 在印度和中东，用左手吃饭被认为是非常粗鲁的。

ex.s: The concept of beauty today is very different from what it was in ancient Greece or the Middle Ages, and so are most of our “laws” of nature.
ex.t: 如今美的概念与古希腊或中世纪时的概念大不相同，我们大多数自然"定律"也是如此。

ex.s: “Miss Ream,” he sighed, “I'd like to let you do it, but as you know, we are in the middle of a war.
ex.t: “里姆小姐，”他叹了口气，“我想让你做，但如你所知，我们正处于战争之中。”

ex.s: On Saturday, we all went to the market right in the middle of the town.
ex.t: 星期六，我们都去了镇中心的集市。

ex.s: Understanding history is vital to understanding ourselves as a people and as a nation． History is much more than the study of dusty old objects and events long past． It is an essential part of who we are today and who we will become． Thornton Middle School History Fair Competition makes understanding history exciting， engaging， and fun!
ex.t: 理解历史对理解我们作为一个民族、一个国家的自我至关重要。历史远不止是对尘封旧物与久远事件的研究。它是我们今天之所是、未来之将是的本质部分。桑顿中学历史博览会竞赛让理解历史变得激动人心、引人入胜且充满乐趣！

ex.s: March 24 Thornton Middle School History Fair Competition
ex.t: 3月24日 桑顿中学历史博览会竞赛

ex.s: Most of my reading through primary， middle and high school was factual reading． I read for knowledge， and to make A's on my tests． Occasionally， I would read a novel that was assigned， but I didn't enjoy this type of reading． I liked facts， things that are concrete． I thought anything abstract left too much room for argument．
ex.t: 在小学、初中和高中阶段，我的大部分阅读都是事实性阅读。我为获取知识而读，为了在考试中拿A。偶尔，我也会读老师指定的小说，但我并不喜欢这种阅读。我喜欢事实，喜欢具体的东西。我认为任何抽象的事物都留下了太多争论的空间。

ex.s: I saw there were two instructors on board and a man lying across the middle.
ex.t: 我看到船上有两名教练，还有一个男人横躺在中间。

ex.s: It was a relief and I came to a suddenly stop just in the middle on the road.
ex.t: 这是一个解脱，我来到一个突然停止 就在中间的道路。

ex.s: The middle part contains the "meat" of the story, with the ending being a summary, a powerful quote or even a surprise for the reader.
ex.t: 中间部分包含了故事的"主体"，结尾则是一个总结、一句有力的引语，甚至是对读者的一个惊喜。

ex.s: Often, a topic sentence comes at the beginning of a paragraph; sometimes, it appears in the middle or at the end.
ex.t: 通常，一个主题句出现在段落的开头；有时，它出现在中间或结尾。

ex.s: Let’s meet in the middle.
ex.t: 我们就折中吧。

ex.s: She looks with agony in the face of the man who has bought her,–a respectable middle-aged man, of benevolent countenance.
ex.t: 她痛苦地望着那个买下她的人的脸——一个可敬的中年男子，一脸仁慈。

ex.s: My life as a tax-paying employed person began in middle school, when, for three whole days, I worked in a baking factory.
ex.t: 我作为一个纳税的上班族的生活始于中学时期，当时我在一家烘焙工厂工作了整整三天。
